intent: CF-V0-010 maps deletion abstention to DELETION_RELATION_REQUIRED and requires PROFILE_REQUIRED / DEFINE_SUPPORTED_PROFILE, because no V0 relation can witness a deletion.

cases.note: A supported deletion hunk whose only basis abstains for deletion. CF-V0-010's membership sentence — "its `relatedIds` are exactly the sorted unique evidence IDs whose LRF edge contributes a retained reason" — is unconditional: it states no exception for the deletion map, and a deletion abstention IS an edge outcome, taken per cited basis. So the one abstaining basis edge contributes DELETION_RELATION_REQUIRED and its evidence ID is retained. The suite originally expected `relatedIds: []` here by analogy with CF-V0-009; that analogy is wrong, because CF-V0-009 and CF-V0-011 say "empty `relatedIds`" in words when they mean it and CF-V0-010 deliberately does not, an asymmetry CF-V0-017 restates as "CEM unknown is empty; unresolved supported CEM uses CF-V0-010".
assertions: CF-V0-010: deletion abstention maps to DELETION_RELATION_REQUIRED.

CF-V0-010: relatedIds are exactly the sorted unique evidence IDs whose LRF edge contributes a retained reason. DELETION_RELATION_REQUIRED is a retained reason and the abstention is an edge outcome, so the abstaining basis's evidence ID is retained; an empty relatedIds here would leave a retained reason no edge contributed.
CF-V0-010: resolutionClass is PROFILE_REQUIRED and nextAction is DEFINE_SUPPORTED_PROFILE, never ACTIONABLE / NARROW_OR_REPLACE_BASIS.
